summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Critical Metals Corp., a foreign private issuer, reporting a PIPE financing transaction. On April 21, 2026, the company entered into securities purchase agreements with accredited investors to sell 5,999,998 ordinary shares for $59,999,980 ($10.00 per share). The offering is exempt under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act. The company will file a resale registration statement within 30 days post-closing. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation like a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. It is an ordinary equity issuance, so the most appropriate category is None.
